public_rationale: The forecast is supported under the stated reading of recurring downward revisions. Sutskever described conventional scaling as reaching limits in late 2024 and explicitly rejected transformative gains from simply increasing scale in 2025. Salesforce leadership separately reported lower confidence in LLMs than a year earlier. These examples support reduced expectations about particular AI approaches. They do not establish an industry-wide retreat or abandonment of AGI: Sutskever had already acknowledged eventual limits, Salesforce disputed the backtracking characterization, and Altman continued to express strong AGI confidence.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'throughout' as recurring examples rather than a sustained industry-wide trend.
The evidence concerns scaling and reliability, not demonstrated postponements of AGI arrival.
The 2024 outcome evidence and Salesforce comparison rely on reporting rather than accessible original interview records.
No finding of dishonest revisionism is proposed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: There will be more revisionism and downsized expectations about AI throughout 2024 and 2025.

statement.excerpt: Expect more revisionism and downsized expectations throughout 2024 and 2025.
statement.document_title: The Great AI Retrenchment has begun

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that prominent AI figures or companies would make further public downward revisions to AI expectations during the remainder of 2024 and during 2025.
A revision must be compared with the same speaker's or company's earlier expectations. An explicit retrospective admission can supply that comparison.
In context, expectations include the capabilities achievable through LLM scaling and the reliability of those capabilities, as well as AGI timelines.
I read 'throughout' as recurring examples in both years. It does not require continuous decline, a majority of companies retreating, or universal abandonment of AGI.
I treat 'revisionism' as changing a previously expressed position, without requiring proof of dishonesty.
criteria.support_condition: Public records establish further downward revisions by prominent AI figures or companies in both the remainder of 2024 and 2025, with an identifiable earlier position or explicit admission of reduced expectations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently broad comparative record establishes that the predicted recurring downward revisions did not occur across both years. Continued optimism by some speakers alone does not contradict a prediction that others would revise expectations.
